data.gender_notes: Gilud is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'gilos', meaning 'joyful'. In Christian tradition, Gilud represents the joy and radiance of the divine presence. The name Gilud carries the meaning “Joyful, radiant” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gilud usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine joy and radiance.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gilud total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
